heroHeadline: Ukraine Destroys Two Tu-142 Aircraft + Iskander-M at Taganrog; Russia Hits 291 Attacks and 277 Guided Bombs; Zelensky Sends Urgent Air Defense Letter to White House
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,556 (May 30), Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces destroyed two irreplaceable Tu-142 maritime patrol aircraft and an Iskander-M missile system at Russia's Taganrog airfield — Major Brovdi confirmed with video. Overnight strikes also hit an oil depot in Armavir (Krasnodar Krai) and a shadow tanker in Taganrog port. Russia responded with 291 combat attacks, 277 guided aerial bombs, and 8,549 kamikaze drones across Ukraine — the Zaporizhzhia Oblast alone faced 976 attacks on 55 settlements; a locomotive engineer was killed by a drone strike on the regional railway. Russian drone also destroyed Shostka railway station in Sumy Oblast. On Day 1,557 (May 31), Zelensky sent an urgent letter to the White House warning of critical air defense interceptor shortages; U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth pledged the U.S. would 'find a way' to help. The EU's €90 billion loan first tranche is approaching for weapons procurement. Russia launched fresh strike waves with Kyiv on high alert; 232 combat engagements recorded by mid-day. Russian losses reached ~1,364,060 personnel total — including 1,560 eliminated in 24 hours on May 31.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, Ukrainska Pravda, Defense News, Euronews, Euromaidan Press, Soufan Center, Meduza, United24 Media, RBC Ukraine, Washington Times, empr.media, Militarnyi, Kyiv Post, and the Ukrainian General Staff. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
